name: Any Android head unit (generic rules)
about: Applied to every unit, under any matching device profile. Lists only AOSP apps whose job is known on every Android build. Nothing here is Recommended: Recommended needs a tested device profile.

packages.risk: No calendar app. The calendar storage provider stays.
Links that open a browser may have nowhere to go if no other browser is installed.
The search bar widget on some factory launchers stops working.
No printing (rare on a head unit).
No voice recorder app. Calls and the microphone are not affected.
Units with a 4G modem may need it for carrier menus and SIM setup.

limitations: Generic rules can't know vendor apps. Everything not listed here or in a device profile stays Unknown.
restore_notes: Every entry here is disabled with pm disable-user and comes back with pm enable.
